content: Create a compelling image that features elements of print media, such as a magnifying glass over an open magazine showcasing articles with vivid images and headlines. Alongside, visualize a hand dropping coins into a jar labelled "Contributions". Add faded images of credit cards and small dollar bills floating in the background to symbolize financial support. The overall colour scheme should evoke trust and reliability, typically using shades of blue or green. Please include the text “Support and Contribute to Keep Our Stories Alive” as part of the image.
